## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if this resolves one.

## Validation

List the commands or checks you ran and their results. For live Altium checks,
include the version and observed outcome; distinguish these from mock or offline tests.

## Notes for review

Mention remaining limitations, affected translations, or changes to bundled sources
when relevant. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/M-R-Abedini/Altium-MCP-Suite/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and test commands.
